https://github.com/luissiviero/sdlc-sample-python/pull/86 — gate (b) **park** (`sdlc:needs-human`), 1 open concern, 0 panel decisions.

**What the owner needs to know**

- **Design is complete.** spec.md and plan.md are on `sdlc/0017/b`. Both intent questions are answered from the code: the part renders with the f-string default as in change 0016, and `percent` keeps its own message so the reader sees the part, not the part times 100.
- **One open concern, left to the owner on purpose.** The intent's Constraints say `tests/test_calc.py` is not changed, but its existing test asserts the old message and fails once the message changes. The design updates that one assertion and records the alternative. No policy settles which intent statement wins.
- **The R7 reading the intent asked for.** The reviewer could not start on the pinned model. The Agent tool returned this with the `opus` alias and again with no alias:

```
API Error: 400 Claude Code 2.1.278 does not support this model; version 2.1.280 or newer is required. (model sent to the API: claude-opus-5-5)
```

  The runner had set `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL=claude-opus-5-5`, so the pin is honoured and the CLI version is the blocker. I ran the reviewer once on the session's model so a real verdict exists. The gate rejected it by design, naming the mismatch. The fix is the owner's: raise `plugin.claude_code` in `sdlc.yaml` to 2.1.280 or later. Phase (c) will hit the same error until then. The panel's advocate uses the same agent and alias, so the panel was not started and the concern stays open. All of this is recorded in plan.md Risks.
- **The reviewer found and I fixed one error.** My first draft said 11 tests would pass after adding one; the suite already has 11, so it is 12. Corrected in spec.md and plan.md, then re-reviewed once for the new HEAD: continue, non-routine.

Nothing else was started. Gate (b) waits for the owner's review on PR 86.
